args.query: The l1 norm or length of a polynomial is nonnegative

items.name: lp.norm_nonneg'
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_3} {E : α → Type u_4} {p : ENNReal} [inst : (i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] (f : ↥(lp E p)), 0 ≤ ‖f‖

items.name: SeminormedSpace.Core.norm_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_6} {E : Type u_7} [inst : NormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : Norm E]
  [inst_3 : Module 𝕜 E], SeminormedSpace.Core 𝕜 E → ∀ (x : E), 0 ≤ ‖x‖

items.name: Polynomial.gaussNorm_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R),
  0 ≤ c → ∀ [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p

items.name: Module.Basis.norm_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : NormedField K] [inst_1 : Ring L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {ι : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : Nonempty ι] (B : Module.Basis ι K L) (x : L), 0 ≤ B.norm x

items.name: Valued.norm_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {L : Type u_1} [inst : Field L] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [val : Valued L Γ₀]
  [hv : Valued.v.RankOne] (x : L), 0 ≤ Valued.norm x

items.name: spectralValueTerms_nonneg
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : SeminormedRing R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ spectralValueTerms p n
